reset_fee: Futures Prime reset $79 (50K) / $149 (100K) / $229 (150K); Futures Prime Extend $99 / $189 / $289; CFD Instant reset at 10% discount (use within 10 days)
refund_policy: 14-day statutory withdrawal right only before the first trade; after that the fee is non-refundable. CFD Prime challenge fee is refunded after the 3rd payout (accounts bought on/after 29 Apr 2026; after the 1st payout for earlier accounts). CFD Instant fee is not refundable.
time_limit: Futures Prime: 30 days (Extend available); Stocks: unlimited; CFD Instant and Futures Instant: no time limit; CFD Prime: none stated
scaling_plan: CFD Prime order summary lists 'Scaling Plan 25%' (details not published); Futures Prime scales contract limits daily with end-of-day profit
max_risk_per_trade: CFD Prime: 1.5% risk and 40% margin per trade idea (accounts created before 29/05/2026, and 1-Phase $100K/$200K); CFD Instant: max position loss 1% ($5K–$20K) / 0.5% ($50K–$100K)
inactivity_rule: Account breached after 21 days with no trade (CFD Prime, Futures Prime); 14 days (Futures Instant, Stocks)
notes: Futures Prime activation fee $0 for new accounts since 26/03/2026 (was $129; existing/reset accounts may still pay). 1% fee deducted from each CFD Prime reward to cover transaction costs. Minimum payout: $100 CFD Prime, $200 CFD Instant and Stocks, $500 Futures Instant. Payout caps: CFD Instant the lower of 50% of profit or $2.5K–$4.5K; Futures Prime 50% of profit capped at $2.5K/$3.5K/$5K; Futures Instant $2K–$3.5K per reward. EAs are allowed with limits (no HFT, latency/arbitrage, copying others' signals). Copy trading is allowed only between your own accounts. Hedging is allowed within one CFD/Stocks account but banned on futures and across accounts. Grid, martingale, gap trading and HFT are prohibited. Proof of ID is required before any payout. The CFD Instant reset discount is recorded as retry_discount_pct=10.
